You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Da na zauna da kishiya gara na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure

output.sadness: Na zauna da kishiya, ya sa na ji kamar na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
output.fear: Da na zauna da kishiya, na ji tsoro har na yi tunanin kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
output.anger: Na zauna da kishiya, da gaske na ji na cije kan na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure!
output.surprise: Na yi mamaki lokacin da na zauna da kishiya, har na yi tunanin kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure!
output.disgust: Sa'a guda da na zauna da kishiya, na ji ta da na kashe kaina – Inji wata Mata da mijinta zai kara aure.
